{"CommandLine":"python3 - << 'EOF'
import urllib.request
import re
import json

targets = [
    ("Oct 2022", "20221022213729", "/product-experience/"),
    ("Oct 2022", "20221022213729", "/digital-adoption/"),
    ("Oct 2022", "20221022213729", "/product/adopt/"),
    ("Oct 2022", "20221022213729", "/product/analytics/"),
    ("Feb 2023", "20230209114429", "/product-experience/user-onboarding/"),
    ("Feb 2023", "20230209114429", "/digital-adoption/employee-productivity/"),
    ("Feb 2023", "20230209114429", "/product/adopt/"),
    ("Feb 2023", "20230209114429", "/products/analytics/"),
    ("Jun 2023", "20230617214543", "/product/adopt/"),
    ("Jun 2023", "20230617214543", "/products/data-sync/"),
    ("Jun 2023", "20230617214543", "/product-experience/product-led-growth/"),
]

results = []

for period, ts, path in targets:
    url = f"https://web.archive.org/web/{ts}/https://www.pendo.io{path}"
    print(f"Fetching {period} - {path} ...")
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as response:
            html = response.read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
            
            # 1. Body classes
            body_match = re.search(r'<body[^>]*class=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', html, re.IGNORECASE)
            body_classes = body_match.group(1) if body_match else "NONE"
            
            # 2. Themes & Plugins
            themes = set(re.findall(r'/wp-content/themes/([^/]+)/', html))
            plugins = set(re.findall(r'/wp-content/plugins/([^/]+)/', html))
            
            # 3. MarTech / Scripts
            martech = {}
            if "mutiny" in html.lower():
                m_tok = re.search(r'client/([a-f0-9]+)\.js', html)
                martech["Mutiny"] = m_tok.group(1) if m_tok else "Present"
            if "munchkin" in html.lower() or "marketo" in html.lower():
                mkto = re.search(r'munchkinId:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', html)
                martech["Marketo"] = mkto.group(1) if mkto else "Present"
            if "gtm-" in html.lower() or "googletagmanager" in html.lower():
                gtm = re.search(r'GTM-[A-Z0-9]+', html)
                martech["GTM"] = gtm.group(0) if gtm else "Present"
            if "6sense" in html.lower() or "company-api.6sense.com" in html.lower():
                martech["6sense"] = "Present"
            if "demandbase" in html.lower() or "scripts.demandbase.com" in html.lower():
                martech["Demandbase"] = "Present"
            if "analytics.js" in html.lower() or "cdn.segment.com" in html.lower():
                martech["Segment"] = "Present"
            if "onetrust" in html.lower() or "cookielaw.org" in html.lower():
                martech["OneTrust"] = "Present"
            if "drift" in html.lower():
                martech["Drift"] = "Present"
            if "wistia" in html.lower() or "fast.wistia.net" in html.lower():
                martech["Wistia"] = "Present"
            if "bizible" in html.lower():
                martech["Bizible"] = "Present"
            if "clearbit" in html.lower():
                martech["Clearbit"] = "Present"

            results.append({
                "period": period,
                "path": path,
                "body_classes": body_classes,
                "themes": list(themes),
                "plugins": list(plugins),
                "martech": martech
            })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Error: {e}")
        results.append({
            "period": period,
            "path": path,
            "error": str(e)
        })

print("\n\n=== SUMMARY OF INSPECTION ===")
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
EOF","Cwd":"/Users/rodneylewis/.gemini/antigravity/brain/fe7a155d-afee-4a93-8fd4-8f5988e7dc37","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Inspecting body classes, themes, plugins, and MarTech","toolSummary":"Inspect Templates and MarTech"}
